title: The Demon Beast
summary: From the slain Void Dragon's skull, Ha-Jun retrieves the Eye of the Night. As he bonds with the Relic, his body undergoes the First True Evolution, unlocking demonic shadow wings.

panels.shot: dissolving dragon skull glowing orb wide shot
panels.action: The massive dragon skeleton dissolves into shimmering violet mist, leaving a dark starry sphere floating.
panels.prose_en: The massive dragon skeleton dissolves into shimmering violet mist, leaving a dark starry sphere floating.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal dragon kankal jhilmilati baingani dhundh mein ghul jata hai, jisse ek gahre taron wala gola tairta rahata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun approaching the floating sphere
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward, the Fang of Abyss sheathed magnetically at his right hip.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward, the Fang of Abyss sheathed magnetically at his right hip.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aage badhta hai, rasatal ka daant uske dahine kulhe par chumbkiya roop se lipta hua hai.

panels.shot: macro on the eye of the night
panels.action: A flawless, deep-indigo celestial orb resembling a miniature galaxy with swirling stars inside a dark iris.
panels.prose_en: A flawless, deep-indigo celestial orb resembling a miniature galaxy with swirling stars inside a dark iris.
panels.prose_hi: Ek dosharahit, gahre neel rang ka akashiya gola jo ek chhoti akashganga jaisa dikhta hai jisme gahre rang ki paritarika ke andar ghumte taare han.

panels.shot: kuro landing beside the orb with awe
panels.action: Kuro folds his wings reverently: 'The Eye of the Night. Rare Relic #6.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh First Sovereign ki right eye thi. Iske andar universe ka all-spectrum vision band hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro folds his wings reverently: 'The Eye of the Night. Rare Relic #6.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne shraddhapurvak apne pankh mode: 'rat ki aankh. durlabh avashesh #6.'

panels.shot: ha-jun raising right hand toward the orb
panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his hand; the celestial orb levitates toward his face like a moth to flame.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun extends his hand; the celestial orb levitates toward his face like a moth to flame.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apna haath badhaya; divya gola patange ki tarah lau ki or uske chehre ki or udta hai.

panels.shot: orb dissolving into indigo starlight
panels.action: The solid orb liquefies into radiant indigo starlight, flowing directly into Ha-Jun's right eye socket.
panels.prose_en: The solid orb liquefies into radiant indigo starlight, flowing directly into Ha-Jun's right eye socket.
panels.prose_hi: Thos gola deeptimaan indigo starlite mein pighal jata hai, jo sidhe Ha-Jun ki dahini aankh ke gartika mein pravahit hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun clutching right eye in sharp gasp
panels.action: Ha-Jun gasps, clutching his right eye as cool, pinprick-sharp starlight integrates into his optic nerves.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Dard nahi hai... Yeh toh bohot thanda hai, jaise barf ki roshni mere dimaag mein utar rahi ho!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gasps, clutching his right eye as cool, pinprick-sharp starlight integrates into his optic nerves.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun hanfta hai, apni dahini aankh ko pakadta hai kyonki thandi, pin-prik-tej taron ki roshni uski optic tantrikaon mein ekikrit ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening right eye: the cosmic iris
panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls his hand away: his right pupil is transformed into a miniature swirling cosmic galaxy of stars.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pulls his hand away: his right pupil is transformed into a miniature swirling cosmic galaxy of stars.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna haath khinch leta hai: uski dahini putli taron ki ek chhoti ghumti hui brahmandiya akashganga mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: what ha-jun sees through the eye of the night
panels.action: The world shifts into high-dimensional clarity: invisible mana ley-lines, structural fractures, and souls glow bright.

dialogue.text: Hawa mein tairte hue har mana particle ka path... Deewaro ke andar ke cracks... Sabkuch saaf dikh raha tha.

panels.prose_en: The world shifts into high-dimensional clarity: invisible mana ley-lines, structural fractures, and souls glow bright.
panels.prose_hi: Duniya ucch-aayami spashtata mein badal jaati hai: adrishya man le-rekhaen, sanrachnatmak fractur, aur aatmayen ujjwal chamakti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at kuro with new vision
panels.action: Through the Eye, Kuro is visible not as a bird, but as a colossal, slumbering 50-foot Phoenix of pure purple fire.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro ka asli form... Yeh toh ek celestial beast hai!

panels.prose_en: Through the Eye, Kuro is visible not as a bird, but as a colossal, slumbering 50-foot Phoenix of pure purple fire.
panels.prose_hi: Aankh ke madhyam se, Kuro ek pakshi ke roop mein nahin, balki shuddh baingani aag ke 50 foot oonche phoenix ke roop mein dikhai deta hai.

panels.shot: sudden volcanic burning between ha-jun shoulder blades
panels.action: Suddenly, Ha-Jun's spine arches as searing heat erupts between his scapula shoulder blades.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: ARGGHHH!! PEECHE... MERI PEETH MEIN KYA HO RAHA HAI?!

panels.prose_en: Suddenly, Ha-Jun's spine arches as searing heat erupts between his scapula shoulder blades.
panels.prose_hi: Achanak, Ha-Jun ki reedh ki haddi jhuk jaati hai kyonki uske scapula kandhe ke blade ke beech jhulsane wali garmi bhadak uthti hai.

panels.shot: kuro flapping backward in alarm and joy
panels.action: Kuro screeches with ecstatic pride: 'THE FIRST TRUE EVOLUTION! Relics ki threshold toot gayi!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Synchronization 45% cross kar chuki hai! Sovereign Wings awaken ho rahe hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro screeches with ecstatic pride: 'THE FIRST TRUE EVOLUTION! Relics ki threshold toot gayi!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro atyant garv se chillata hai: 'pahla sachcha vikas! avsheshon ki dahalij toot gai!'.

panels.shot: black demonic mana erupting from shoulder blades
panels.action: Two geysers of dense obsidian and violet shadow smoke erupt violently from his upper back.
panels.prose_en: Two geysers of dense obsidian and violet shadow smoke erupt violently from his upper back.
panels.prose_hi: Ghane obsidian aur baingani chhaya ke do geyser se dhuan uski upari peeth se teji se foot raha tha.

panels.shot: shadows solidifying into feathered dragon wings
panels.action: The smoke condenses into a magnificent pair of 12-foot wings: razor-sharp obsidian feathers and bone joints.
panels.prose_en: The smoke condenses into a magnificent pair of 12-foot wings: razor-sharp obsidian feathers and bone joints.
panels.prose_hi: Dhuan sanghanit hokar 12 foot ke pankhon ki ek shandar jodi mein badal jata hai: rezar-nukile obsidian pankh aur haddi ke jod.

panels.shot: ha-jun lifted 20 feet into the air by wing flap
panels.action: A single involuntary beat of the wings generates a hurricane gale, launching Ha-Jun 20 feet skyward.
panels.prose_en: A single involuntary beat of the wings generates a hurricane gale, launching Ha-Jun 20 feet skyward.
panels.prose_hi: Pankhon ki ek anaichhik dhadkan ek toofani aandhi utpann karti hai, jo Ha-Jun ko 20 feet upar aakash ki or le jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun hovering in midair wide hero shot
panels.action: Ha-Jun hovers in the colosseum dome: black windbreaker, glowing galaxy right eye, bone gauntlet, and dark wings.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hovers in the colosseum dome: black windbreaker, glowing galaxy right eye, bone gauntlet, and dark wings.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun colosium ke gumbad mein mandarata hai: kala vindbraker, chamakti akashganga dahini aankh, haddi ka kavach aur gahre pankh.

panels.shot: system interface milestone announcement
panels.action: Diamond gothic interface scrolls with cosmic golden borders.

dialogue.text:
[BLOODLINE EVOLUTION: STAGE 2 UNLOCKED]
Synchronization: 45.0%
New Trait: Sovereign Shadow Wings (Flight Speed: Mach 1.5)
New Relic: Eye of the Night (All-Spectrum Mana Sight Active).

panels.prose_en: Diamond gothic interface scrolls with cosmic golden borders.
panels.prose_hi: Cosmik golden border ke saath diamond gothic interface scrol.

panels.shot: ha-jun experimenting with wing control
panels.action: Ha-Jun mentally commands the wings; they fold tightly against his back like an aerodynamic black cloak.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh wings mere mind se connect hain. Ek thought aur main hawa mein swim kar sakta hoon.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun mentally commands the wings; they fold tightly against his back like an aerodynamic black cloak.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun mansik roop se pankhon ko aadesh deta hai; ve ek vayugatikiy kale labade ki tarah uski peeth ke khilaf kaskar mude hue han.

panels.shot: kuro flying up to hover beside him
panels.action: Kuro grins with demonic joy: 'Now you look like the Sovereign's true heir. Magnificent!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ab koi wall ya chasm tumhe rok nahi sakti.

panels.prose_en: Kuro grins with demonic joy: 'Now you look like the Sovereign's true heir. Magnificent!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro shaitani demonic khushi se muskurata hai: 'ab aap samprabhu ke sacche uttaradhikari ki tarah dikhte han. shandar!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating eye of the night to scan horizon
panels.action: Ha-Jun gazes out through the broken dome of the amphitheater across the demon realm.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gazes out through the broken dome of the amphitheater across the demon realm.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun emphitheater ke toote hue gumbad ke madhyam se danav kshetra ko dekhta hai.

panels.shot: what the eye sees across the realm
panels.action: A glowing red mana thread stretches five miles northwest, leading into an ominous black iron fortress.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhai ka blood thread... Wahan ja raha hai. Us kaali fortress ke andar!

panels.prose_en: A glowing red mana thread stretches five miles northwest, leading into an ominous black iron fortress.
panels.prose_hi: Ek chamakta hua lal maina dhaga uttar-pashchim mein paanch meal tak faila hua hai, jo ek ashubh kale lohe ke kile ki or jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro looking in the same direction
panels.action: Kuro's expression darkens: 'The Citadel of the Silent Prison... Valac ka territory.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Woh fortress pure anti-mana void stone se bani hai. Wahan active spells kaam nahi karte.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's expression darkens: 'The Citadel of the Silent Prison... Valac ka territory.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki abhivyakti gahri ho gai hai: 'cylent jail ka garh... valack ka kshetra.'

panels.shot: ha-jun touching the fang of abyss at his hip
panels.action: Ha-Jun's hand rests on the spatial dagger: 'Lekin yeh dagger space ko cut karta hai... Anti-mana stone iske saamne kuch nahi.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Unka anti-mana void humein rok nahi payega.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's hand rests on the spatial dagger: 'Lekin yeh dagger space ko cut karta hai... Anti-mana stone iske saamne kuch nahi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka haath sthanik khanjar par tika hua hai: 'lakin yeh khanjar antriksh ko kaatata hai... anti-man stone iske samne kuch nahin.'

panels.shot: ha-jun flexing wings to accelerate
panels.action: Ha-Jun angles his body forward, his shadow wings flaring with violet jet propulsion.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun angles his body forward, his shadow wings flaring with violet jet propulsion.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne shareer ko aage ki or jhuka liya hai, uske chhaya pankh baingani jet pranodan se chamak rahe han.

panels.shot: breaking the sound barrier over necrothea
panels.action: Ha-Jun shoots forward in a blinding sonic boom, streaking across the twin-mooned sky like a black comet.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun shoots forward in a blinding sonic boom, streaking across the twin-mooned sky like a black comet.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek chakachaundh kar dene wale dhwani ufaan mein aage badhta hai, jo ek kale dhumketu ki tarah judvan-chand wale aakash mein ghumta hai.

panels.shot: citadel of the silent prison looming ahead
panels.action: A terrifying 500-foot monolithic black fortress carved directly into a sheer cliff of anti-matter stone.
panels.prose_en: A terrifying 500-foot monolithic black fortress carved directly into a sheer cliff of anti-matter stone.
panels.prose_hi: Ek bhayanak 500 foot ka akhand kala kila sidhe anti-mater patthar ki khadi chattan mein khuda hua hai.

panels.shot: chains of dark energy anchoring the fortress
panels.action: Massive thousand-ton iron chains anchor the floating prison island to the bottomless void below.
panels.prose_en: Massive thousand-ton iron chains anchor the floating prison island to the bottomless void below.
panels.prose_hi: Hajaron ton ki vishal lohe ki janjeeren tairte hue jail dweep ko neeche athah shunya mein bandhe rakhti han.

panels.shot: kuro pointing claw at the anchor chains
panels.action: Kuro shouts over the wind: 'Wo chains dekho! The Chains of Ruin! Relic #7 wahan hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The Chains of Ruin! Woh fortress ko hold kar rahi hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro shouts over the wind: 'Wo chains dekho! The Chains of Ruin! Relic #7 wahan hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro hawa mein chillata hai: 'vo chain dekho! barbadi ki janjiren! avashesh #7 vahan hai!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun diving toward the fortress rooftop
panels.action: Ha-Jun tucks his wings, diving headfirst at 500 mph toward the silent prison fortress.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tucks his wings, diving headfirst at 500 mph toward the silent prison fortress.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne pankh failata hai aur 500 meal prati ghante ki raftaar se shant jail kile ki or gota lagata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing silently on the black iron parapet
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands with zero sound on the anti-mana battlements, eyes gleaming in the shadow: 'Bhai, main aa gaya.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh prison tod kar... Main tumhe wapas le jaunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands with zero sound on the anti-mana battlements, eyes gleaming in the shadow: 'Bhai, main aa gaya.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shunya dhwani ke saath anti-mana battlement par utarta hai, aankhen chhaya mein chamakti han: 'bhai, main aa gaya.'
